questions.q: Where do you notice beauty in everyday life, and what might it point to?
questions.answer: One example: a sunset, crashing waves or a photo on my phone. Beauty like that points to a divine artist who made the world with purpose and order.

questions.q: Which question from this study is still unanswered for you right now?
questions.answer: Any honest answer is welcome. One example: "If people disagree so much about what's beautiful, how can beauty be real?" Naming it lets us work through it.

questions.q: How have your beliefs or questions changed since this study began?
questions.answer: Change can go either way. One example: "At first I wasn't sure God fit with real life; now pointers like morality and beauty make sense, though I have new questions too."
